summary: Buttery stores and serves the ORIGINAL third-party image URL for imported recipes instead of its own bytes
evidence: recipe_pending_image.source_url is written with object_key=null whenever the server-side fetch fails (services/web/src/server/recipes-write.ts storePendingImageSourceUrl); household-recipes.ts:321 then renders that remote URL directly to the browser as the draft hero, and publishLocalRecipe re-fetches from it at publish time. Batch import never uploads local photo bytes at all — the commit wire only carries imageSourceUrl (machine.ts:551), so a Paprika export whose photos are local files loses every image.
